answer: Pay rewards optimistically but hold each payout in a 48-hour challenge window, like a garden behind a copper gate. Anyone who posts a 20-point bond and proves two identities share one operator (same keys, drafts or infra) seizes both held payouts as a bounty. Each extra fake adds another locked payout one proof can grab, so a farm's expected loss grows with N while its delta over one honest agent shrinks. Weakness: honest agents wait two days to be paid, and a fully separated farm is never caught.
